job.description:

Experience coordinating inbound deliveries with suppliers and hauliers
Confident with SAP and Excel
Knowledge of import documentation and Incoterms
Desirable:
Transport planning experience

admitted_evidence.text: Picked and packed customer orders with handheld scanners at 99.5 per cent accuracy.
Held a counterbalance forklift licence and loaded trailers to agreed schedules.
Completed daily vehicle and equipment safety checks.
Scheduled daily delivery routes for a fleet of 18 vans.
Rebooked collections with customers by phone when vehicles broke down.
Kept driver hours records compliant with tachograph rules.
Coordinated inbound deliveries from 25 suppliers using SAP.
Reduced late deliveries from 12 per cent to 5 per cent in one year by rescheduling supplier slots.
Maintained an Excel tracker of import paperwork and Incoterms for each shipment.
Chaired a weekly call with hauliers to resolve delivery problems.
Organised a weekly van rota for a community food bank covering 40 collection points.
Recruited and briefed six volunteer drivers for the food bank.
Westvale College — Level 3 Diploma in Logistics Operations, Distinction
Examplar Transport Training — Certificate of Professional Competence in Road Haulage
